name: Hosteria Modal Gallery
author: Dolzhenkov

sections.description:
Hosteria Modal Gallery is a lightweight, responsive lightbox plugin for WordPress that automatically converts standard image links and native WordPress attachment galleries into a modern, full-screen modal slider powered by Swiper.js.

The plugin is designed for performance and seamless integration, working automatically out of the box without requiring shortcodes or complex setup.

Features:

  • Automatically detects direct image links and native WordPress attachment galleries.

  • Full keyboard navigation support (Left/Right arrow keys to slide, Escape to close).

  • Touch swipe gestures for mobile devices and mouse wheel scrolling on desktop.

  • Smooth image pinch-to-zoom and double-tap zoom functionality.

  • Customizable background color options via the WordPress admin panel.

  • Optional image captions extracted from alt attributes.

  • Built-in lazy loading for optimized page speeds.

  • Translation ready.

  • Configured using native WordPress Settings API.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/hosteria-modal-gallery/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.

  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.

  3. Open Hosteria Modal Gallery from the WordPress dashboard to configure plugin options.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require shortcodes?

No. It automatically detects direct image links and WordPress attachment galleries on your pages.

Can I navigate the gallery using a keyboard?

Yes. You can use the Left and Right arrow keys to navigate between slides, and the Escape key to close the gallery modal.

Can I display image captions?

Yes. Enable the option in the plugin settings to display captions from the image alt attribute.
